title: Gov. Braun and Mayor Jensen to assess Noblesville flooding and recovery efforts
text:
Gov. Braun and Mayor Jensen to assess Noblesville flooding and recovery efforts
Indiana Governor Mike Braun and Noblesville Mayor Chris Jensen will assess damage from recent flooding in Noblesville and ensure that state resources are available to support recovery efforts, according to an Aug. 19 advisory. Following the assessment, Braun and Jensen will hold a media availability at the Noblesville Public Safety Building - Station 71 Bay.
The event is scheduled for Thursday, August 20 at 3:45 PM Eastern Time at the Noblesville Public Safety Building located at 135 S 9th Street, Noblesville, Indiana. Media representatives planning to attend must RSVP with Griffin Reid, Press Secretary for the Office of Governor Mike Braun.
Braun has contributed to public service through roles on school boards and in state representation, achieved growth of his company into a national entity employing thousands, championed over 40 bills that became law during his Senate term, has been married for 49 years and raised four children, won election to the U.S. Senate in 2018 before becoming governor, and graduated summa cum laude with a degree in economics from Wabash College as well as earning an MBA from Harvard Business School, according to the official website.
Further details about specific recovery plans or additional statements from officials were not provided in the advisory.
